notes.title: SSA Patch Notes – 2025_7_2
notes.notes: [h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mantis Kill Reward[/b]: Now granted to [b]all living teammates[/b], not just those nearby.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minion Balance[/b]: Slight [b]reduction in damage and HP[/b] to improve early game pacing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jungle Tweaks[/b]: [b]Non-boss jungle units[/b] now deal slightly less damage.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Feature: Command (Ping) System[/h3][p]A brand-new [b]ping wheel system[/b] has been added for faster and more strategic in-game communication:[/p][h3]How It Works:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Hold Left Shift[/b] to open the Command Wheel. Move your mouse in a direction to select a command, then [b]release Shift[/b] to send it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ping via minimap or ally portraits[/b] is also supported.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Right-click[/b] cancels the wheel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keyboard shortcut (1–6)[/b] support for fast access.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Anti-Spam Logic:[/h3][list][*][p]Sending 5 commands within 5 seconds will [b]lock the system for 5 seconds[/b] to prevent spam.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Default Commands:[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Caution[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Setting Course[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Need Assistance[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Missing[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Engage[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Survey the Area[/b][/p][/*][/olist][h3]Contextual Side Commands:[/h3][p]Depending on the target (ally, jungle, structure), commands adapt contextually. For example:[/p][list][*][p][b]Caution[/b] + ally = “X, Fall Back”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engage[/b] + enemy structure = “Attack X”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Need Assistance[/b] + base = “Defend X”[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted [b]engine sounds[/b] for Inso, FF machine gun, and all XBT units for better clarity and mix.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SSA Team[/b][/p]

- Flamethrower damage reduced at early levels. (Level 20 damage unchanged)

[h3][b]Ironclad[/b][/h3]
- Increased damage at early levels. (Level 20 damage unchanged)
- Health regeneration increased.
- All physical defenses increased by 10 points.
- Triangle Formation defense reduction value corrected.

[h3]Queen[/h3]

Smoothbore and Heat Ammo damage increased at early levels. (Level 20 damage unchanged)
Health regeneration increased.

[h3]🛠 Equipment[/h3]

Shield price increased from 1500 to 2000.

notes.title: STEEL SWARM: APOCALYPSE – PATCH NOTES 2025_4_2
notes.notes:
[h3]🖱️ Right Click[h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now right-click on either the [b]minimap[/b] or the [b]main game screen[/b] to instantly command their [b]XBT to move to that location.[/b]
[*] This feature allows for faster and more intuitive unit control, especially in high-pressure combat scenarios.
[*] It works seamlessly with both[b] standard [/b]and[b] free camera modes.[/b]
[/list]
